sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining — when any link in the chain is nil, the entire expression silently evaluates to nil, propagating absence without error.
sketches.resonance: The way one missing person makes every connection after them dissolve into nothing.

sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics — after a value is moved to another binding, the original binding is no longer valid and cannot be used, enforced at compile time.
sketches.resonance: Giving yourself completely to someone means you are no longer yours; the compiler refuses to let you pretend otherwise.

sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation with an infinite list — the expression defines something unbounded but only materializes what is demanded, never completing.
sketches.resonance: Hope is an infinite sequence we keep taking from, one element at a time, never reaching the end because reaching the end would mean there is none left.
sketches.draft:
hope :: [Integer]
hope = [1..]

lived :: [Integer]
lived = take 1 hope
